says: The inside of a vast turning cylinder, seen from a balcony high on its near end: land all round and overhead, towns and a lake on it, a chain of small suns along its middle, long windows down its length, and a sun low in a window at the far end.

lights.says: The sun low in the window at the far end, and the warm light it sends down the world
That sun's gold beam through the long window on the right, lying as a band of gold across the land on the left
The chain of small suns along the world's middle, dim at dusk, and the warm light they cast on the land overhead
The sky's light coming in through the long windows
Every town's windows and street lamps, and the balcony's lanterns

places.says: The lantern tower on the knoll by the lake below the balcony
The town just past the lake, a little to the right
A town up the land rising on the left
A town up the land rising on the right
A town high overhead, toward the right
A town far down the world, up on the left
A town far down the world, up on the right
A town at the foot of the far end, under the sunset
